ai.title: Git stage command execution order
ai.summary: Moved `stagePatches` call to precede `applyChanges` in `npm-app/src/cli.ts`. Ensures previous changes are staged before new file modifications are applied. Scope limited to CLI git staging logic. Prevents race condition where new changes might be inadvertently staged or previous changes missed.

eli5.text: When you use the assistant and have it set up to automatically save your previous work to your project's version history, the order of operations has been corrected so that your earlier changes are properly recorded before new edits are applied. This prevents a situation where your previous work might not get saved or where new and old changes could get mixed up together. The fix is live today for anyone using this auto-save feature.
